name: TVHeadend EX
description: TVHeadend EX is an independent, unofficial TVHeadend integration for Jellyfin. It began as a fork of jellyfin/jellyfin-plugin-tvheadend and has since been developed separately, with its own playback architecture and its own plugin identity. Alpha: expect breakage, and read the changelog before installing.
overview: Live TV and recordings from TVHeadend -- an independent plugin, alpha builds
